provenance: v1.2.0: user-supplied gaze_grid_v2 (81 straight-alpha poses) and left/right hop_v2 (48 frames / 800ms each), losslessly paged. Gaze coordinates and hop_offset_curve are validated and integrated into runtime. Surprise v2 and other actions retain v1.1.2 pixels and alpha storage modes.
pixel_hash_semantics: sha256 is runtime RGBA pixel hash. source_pixel_sha256 preserves supplied RGBA hash for repaired frames; source_file_sha256 is the original PNG file hash.

postprocessing.surprise: User-supplied v2, lossless page packing only
postprocessing.page_alpha_mode: Explicit metadata; no source pixel rewriting
postprocessing.optional_rim_variant: Not imported; changes locked neutral frames and is inconsistent with other actions.
